# Night Shift Tint

> Window tinting service in Cedar City, Utah. In-shop and mobile window tint for cars, trucks, SUVs, UTVs, heavy equipment, campers, homes and businesses across Southern Utah. Shop at 690 N 5400 W, Cedar City, UT 84721. Phone (208) 339-5003. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews. Owner and installer: Tayson.

## Services
- Geoshield C2 ceramic window tint for cars, trucks and SUVs, computer-cut patterns
- UTV and side-by-side tint (Polaris RZR, Ranger, General, Xpedition; Can-Am Maverick, Defender)
- Heavy equipment cab tint (excavators, dozers, skid steers, tractors)
- Camper and RV window tint
- Residential window film
- Commercial and storefront window film

## Hours
Monday 9:30 AM to 5 PM; Tuesday 7 AM to 7 PM; Wednesday to Saturday 9 AM to 5 PM; Sunday closed. Mobile appointments by booking.

## Areas served
Cedar City, Enoch, Parowan, Kanarraville, Brian Head, Iron County and Southern Utah

## Facts
- Utah law: front side windows must let in more than 43% of light; back side and rear windows can be any darkness with dual side mirrors; windshield tint only on the top 4 inches or above the AS-1 line.
- Free quotes by phone or text at (208) 339-5003.
